Execution boundary

MetricFlow is a semantic query engine over dbt models. It owns metric logic, safe entity joins, time behavior, exports, and managed caching; ingestion, recursive preparation, warehouse authorization, and consumer presentation keep separate owners.

Modeling boundary

Metrics-as-code still depends on trustworthy grain.

MetricFlow prevents unsafe join paths and recalculates governed metrics, but it cannot recover discarded entity identities, turn a repeated scalar into a key-aware sum, or make incompatible sources queryable together. The catalog calls those limits out directly.
